common.rating_editions: All opened 2026-11-14. (C) current global and US pages, identical; portfolio PDF Jan 2026 (p. 20 data sheet, p. 24 PG table) - KB5S 4.0 MW(e), 29.7 %, 12,137 kJ/kWh, 14,200 rpm, PR 10.3, 15.4 kg/s, 560 C; KB7S 5.4 MW(e), 32.3 %, 11,146, 14,600 rpm, PR 14.2, 21.3 kg/s, 495 C; KB7HE 5.8 MW(e), 33.2 %, 10,889, 14,600 rpm, PR 14.4, 21.4 kg/s, 520 C. Portfolio imperial layer prints KB7HE PR '14.1 : 1' (metric layer 14.4). (B) poster (PDF 2021-08, linked from the page): same except KB7HE exhaust '508 °C (972 °F)' and KB7S '495 °C (921 °F)'. (B') brochure at the page's link (PDF 2021-09, file name '2018-v8'): same as C except KB7HE exhaust '508 °C (946 °F)'. (A) CN and BR pages: same as C except KB7HE efficiency 32.7 % and °F pairs 925 / 965 °F. The prelim record's '2018 brochure: 11,152 kJ/kWh, PR 13.9' (KB7S) and '10,848 kJ/kWh, PR 14.0' (KB7HE) were not found in any opened document: the document at the cited assets URL prints 11,146 / 14.2 and 10,889 / 14.4; 11,152 and 10,848 equal the Btu figures 10,570 and 10,281 Btu/kWh converted; PR 13.9 / 14.0 stay unverified (the etn.global copy is outside the allowed network). Rule: current manufacturer page (C) for power, heat rate, efficiency, flow, temperature, PR, speed; package dimensions from the same page; package systems from the Centrax package datasheets (third party, Siemens-authorised packager).
common.rating_basis: Brochure p. 5 footnote: 'Nominal uninstalled new engine performance with no inlet or exhaust ducting losses, ISO conditions, 0% relative humidity, gaseous fuel with lower heating value of 20,400 BTU/lb (47,496 kJ/kg). Assumes 98.5% generator efficiency and 60 kw shaft gearbox power loss. Power, efficiency and heat rate all based on electrical power output measured at generator terminals.' Portfolio p. 3: 'All simple cycle and mechanical drive performance data in this document are gross values at ISO ambient conditions.' Page: conditions not printed ('Gross efficiency'). Centrax (other basis): 15 °C, 0 m, 1013 mbar, 60 % RH, LHV 47497 kJ/kg, '* Inlet losses, exhaust losses & package auxiliary losses are excluded' - Centrax KB5 3903 kWe / 12,557 kJ/kWh / 15.7 kg/s / 555 C; KB7HE 5624 kWe / 11,245 / 21.3 / 515 C (not mixed with Siemens ISO values).
common.pkg_basis: Siemens page and portfolio p. 20: 'Power generation package | Approx. weight 35,000 kg (85,980 lb) | Length 9 m (29.5 ft) | Width 2.7 m (8.9 ft) | Height 3.1 m (10.2 ft)'; 'Note: Above dimensions exclude inlet filter housing and exhaust stack. For power generation, the AC generator is included.' One package for all three variants. Centrax CXA05 KB5 and KB7 HE drawings (identical): 11522 mm / 453 in long, 4755 mm / 187 in wide, 7182 mm / 282 in high, 1503 mm / 57 in overhang, 'Approx total weight = 55000 KG / 121254 lbs' - package with acoustic enclosure, air intake and exhaust on top (drawing), other basis, not mixed. Centrax page: 'generator set load of only 40 tonnes'. Centrax CXA05 Mobile drawing (labels read from the vector drawing): trailer 15157 [596.72"], overall with tractor 16154 [636"], height 4204 [165.5"] ± 25.4, width 2611 [102.81"] door latches, 'CG OF GENSET PACKAGE 44892.8 KG [98970 LBS]'.
common.pkg_check: Length/width/height pairs consistent (29.5 ft = 8.99 m; 8.9 ft = 2.71 m; 10.2 ft = 3.11 m). Weight pair NOT consistent: 85,980 lb = 39,000 kg; 35,000 kg = 77,162 lb; the same pair is printed on global, US, CN, BR pages and in the portfolio. Centrax drawing pairs: 121254 lb = 55,000 kg (ok); 187 in = 4750 mm (4755), 282 in = 7163 mm (7182), 453 in = 11506 mm (11522), 57 in = 1448 mm (1503) - Centrax inch values loose.
common.engine_envelope: Siemens brochure p. 11: 'The SGT-A05 measures less than 2.7 meters (8 feet) long and weighs less than 766 Kg (1,690 pounds).' Upper bounds, not values; 8 ft = 2.44 m does not match 2.7 m (8.86 ft); 1,690 lb = 766.6 kg. Centrax: KB5 'Aero-derivative single shaft design 800kg (1764lb)'; KB7HE '1000kg (2205lb)' (both above the Siemens bound - Centrax mass likely with boost module/accessories; basis not stated). Diameter not published. engine_kg left null in all PG records (skeptic 2026-11-14): Siemens bound and Centrax values exclude each other, basis of neither stated.
common.fuel_gas: Supply pressure not published (Siemens page, brochure, poster, portfolio; Centrax datasheets). Published: 'On-skid fuel system includes all components needed to control fuel during start-up and operation' (brochure p. 13); fuels natural gas, liquid (DF-2), dual, mid/low BTU, steam and water injection, DLE; H2: page 'equipped with WLE burners, is capable to burn up to 15 vol% of hydrogen'; brochure 'capable of operating on 30% vol. hydrogen with minimal hardware changes on DLE and WLE systems'; Centrax 'Up to 30% hydrogen fuel mix'.
common.combustor: Centrax: '6 axial flow combustion chambers (cans)', 'Standard ignition system, 2 exciters and 2 ignitors'. Siemens: three combustion systems (standard, WLE, DLE 25 vppm NOx / 50 vppm CO).
common.maintenance: Page: 'A direct core engine exchange is possible and can be executed in as little as 12 hours.'; 'up to seven years baseload duty between full overhaul'. Brochure p. 11 (2021): 'A direct core engine exchange is possible and can be executed in a single 8 hr work shift.'; 'up to 32,000 hours baseload duty between full overhaul'. Start: page 'full power available within 60 seconds'; portfolio p. 20 'Full engine power available within 60-90 seconds in all conditions, pending local and package requirements.'
common.interface: Output flange, coupling, mounting feet, inlet/exhaust flanges, rotation: not published. Published: single shaft, cold end (compressor end) power take-off ('Single shaft cold end drive', brochure p. 8; Centrax 'Power take-off shaft assembly (cold end drive)'); package epicyclic gearbox to 1500/1800 rpm, 4-pole generator, 'Close-coupled generator/gearbox' (Centrax); exhaust 'Axial exhaust exit' (Centrax). Centrax general CXA05 page says 'Package not bolted down' while the datasheets say 'Transmits all package loads to the foundation via anchor bolts' - conflicting, not resolved.
common.md_offer: No mechanical-drive rating is published for SGT-A05: the page has only 'Simple cycle power generation'; the portfolio Jan 2026 mechanical-drive tables (p. 24, metric and imperial layers) list no SGT-A05; the brochure covers power generation only. Historical two-shaft industrial 501-K drive versions were not found in any opened document.
common.track_note: gtu-fleet skill (ocm-research-diary, section 2): 'SGT-A05 есть в предварительном файле, но в перечне трека не назван - без решения владельца не заводить'. This file is a scratchpad verification result only; it was not added to routes/gtu/fleet.

records.notes: Efficiency is now published on the Siemens page ('Gross efficiency 32.3%'; prelim said not stated) and equals 3600/HR. All rating fields confirmed on page, poster, brochure, portfolio. comp_stages is a composite of published statements, not a published count: Siemens brochure KB7S 'Addition of single stage compressor boost module' + 'Core engine commonality with SGT-A05 family', Centrax KB5 core '14 Stage axial compressor' and KB7HE '14 Stage axial compressor with additional zero stage boost module'. turb_stages 4 on the same commonality basis. engine_kg, bearing count and bleed-valve count are not published for KB7S (KB7HE values 6, 9 and the unresolved Centrax 1000 kg not transferred). Starter and lube tank are of the Centrax KB7 package (its datasheet is titled KB7 HE). pkg_kg null - see conflicts.

records.comp_stages: 15 (14-stage axial compressor + additional zero-stage boost module)
records.out_rpm: 14600 rpm - engine (single shaft) 'Turbine speed' = input of the package epicyclic gearbox; generator 1500 (50 Hz) / 1800 (60 Hz) rpm (Centrax)

extra.power_at: generator terminals, gross ISO ('Power output | 4.0 MW(e) | 5.4 MW(e) | 5.8 MW(e)', 'Gross efficiency'; brochure: 'based on electrical power output measured at generator terminals', 98.5 % generator efficiency and 60 kW gearbox loss assumed)
extra.out_rpm_at: engine (single shaft) speed = input speed of the package epicyclic reduction gearbox
extra.driven_rpm: 1500 (50 Hz) / 1800 (60 Hz) - third party Centrax: 'Reduce engine speed down to 1500rpm (50Hz) or 1800rpm (60Hz)', generator '4 poles'
extra.gearbox: package epicyclic speed reduction gearbox (Centrax 'Epicyclic speed reduction gearbox'); Siemens brochure rating assumes '60 kw shaft gearbox power loss'
extra.power_take_off: cold end (compressor end) drive: Siemens brochure KB5S 'Single shaft cold end drive'; Centrax 'Power take-off shaft assembly (cold end drive)'
extra.inlet_exhaust_dp_note: 0 = rating basis, not package dp: brochure 'Nominal uninstalled new engine performance with no inlet or exhaust ducting losses'; brochure curves 'excluding package inlet and outlet losses but including gearbox and generator losses'; Centrax '* Inlet losses, exhaust losses & package auxiliary losses are excluded'. Actual package inlet and exhaust pressure losses are not published.

variable_geometry.text: Not mentioned in any opened document (Siemens page, poster, brochure, portfolio; Centrax datasheets). Surge protection is by blow-off valves (Centrax).

(brochure 2021: 'in a single 8 hr work shift'). Removal direction, lift weight and clearances not published.

conflicts.why: skeptic 2026-11-14: unresolved - OEM Siemens brochure (2021-09, p. 11) bounds the SGT-A05 engine at 'less than 766 Kg (1,690 pounds)' (1,690 lb = 766.6 kg), the Siemens-listed packager Centrax prints 'Aero-derivative single shaft design 1000kg (2205lb)' (2205 lb = 1000.2 kg) for KB7HE; the two exclude each other unless the mass bases differ, and neither document states its basis (bare engine vs with accessories / PTO shaft). Third-party value is for cross-check only (gtu-fleet skill, section 3); no second source - taken null. Size lifting for >= 1000 kg.

extra.check: Second document: page = US page = brochure p. 5 = portfolio p. 24 metric for power, efficiency, heat rate, speed, PR, flow; temperature 520 °C on page and portfolio (both layers), 508 °C in brochure 2021 and poster (see conflicts). Internal: 10,281 Btu/kWh x 1.05506 = 10,847 kJ/kWh (vs 10,889, -0.4 %); 3600/10,889 = 33.06 % vs printed 33.2 % (0.14 pp); 47.1 lb/s = 21.36 kg/s; 968 F = 520.0 C. 5.8/5.4 = +7.4 % vs brochure '8% power increase'; 1 - 10,889/11,146 = 2.31 % vs brochure '2.3 % improvement'. Energy balance q = 1.019 at 520 °C (0.994 at 508 °C), band 0.88-1.06. Centrax KB7HE: 5624 kWe, 21.3 kg/s, 515 °C, PR 14.4, q = 0.98.

records.notes: Highest-power variant: KB7S + High Efficiency Compressor upgrade (KB7S retrofittable). Power, heat rate, flow, PR, speed confirmed on page, brochure, poster, portfolio; exhaust temperature 520 °C on current page and portfolio Jan 2026, 508 °C in brochure 2021 (both kept in conflicts). eff_pct 33.2 is printed but 3600/10,889 = 33.06 % - see conflicts. Stages, bleed valves, bearings, starter, lube tank from the Centrax KB7 HE package datasheet. engine_kg null (skeptic 2026-11-14): Centrax 1000 kg vs Siemens family '< 766 kg' - unresolved, see conflicts. pkg_kg null - see conflicts.

extra.text: No mechanical-drive rating is published for SGT-A05: the page has only 'Simple cycle power generation'; the portfolio Jan 2026 mechanical-drive tables (p. 24, metric and imperial layers) list no SGT-A05; the brochure covers power generation only. Historical two-shaft industrial 501-K drive versions were not found in any opened document.
